call_points.text: India business guided to high single-digit growth, closing the gap to market.
API growth seen around 10%, with Q1 running ahead of that level.
Core margin to improve to high teens, offset by 150 bps dilution from US branded; FY27 reported margin roughly flat to slightly better.
Q1 margin dilution from US branded was higher than the 150 bps full-year guide.
Bosutinib launched in June with one month of sales; exclusivity runs to November.
Preventive debottlenecking at the Ophthaline facility expanded capacity with no incremental capex, but caused Q1 under-absorption.
Management declined to quantify the amortisation of US branded intangibles, saying it would follow up.
Consolidated top-line growth guided in the **low double-digit range** for FY27.
International generic business expected to grow in **low to mid-teen range**; API business to grow **high single or low double-digit** in FY27.
FY27 capex guided at **₹300 Cr to ₹350 Cr**, focused on debottlenecking and replacement.
US branded launch of **Pivya** expected to create a **100 to 150 bps** margin drag before turnaround.
Aims to return to **20% EBITDA margins** over a 2 to 3 year period as operating leverage improves.
Ophthalmic line at **F3 facility** is fully utilized, prompting an expansion.
Ex-US markets grew **20%** in FY26, despite a muted fourth quarter due to a higher base.

operating_notes.text: Alembic Pharmaceuticals incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Alembic Pharmaceuticals GmbH, in Germany with EUR 25,000 share capital.
Alembic Pharma received USFDA final approval for Fingolimod Capsules 0.5 mg with US$ 145 million market size.
Alembic Pharma received USFDA tentative approval for Darolutamide Tablets 300 mg with US$ 3,155 million market size.
Alembic entered the US branded business through Alembic Therapeutics with the launch of Pivya.
Karakhadi API-III facility cleared Brazil ANVISA GMP inspection with zero observations in May 2026.
Indore facility is fully operational with improving capacity utilization.
F3 ophthalmic line is at full capacity with an expansion underway.
Launched Pivya in late February 2026 under Alembic Therapeutics in the US branded market.
Received USFDA final approval for Haloperidol Tablets, USP (1 mg, 2 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, and 20 mg) with an addressable market of USD 27 million.
Executed a Shareholders’ Agreement to acquire a 45% equity stake in 17989377 Canada Inc. as an associate company.
US Generics grew 49% YoY in rupee terms and about 37-38% in constant currency in Q1FY27.
Bosutinib launched in June 2026 with 180-day exclusivity on the 100mg and 500mg strengths running to November.
Animal Health is about 22% of India business revenue and acute about 37%; specialty is close to 60% of total revenue.
USFDA final approval for Ciprofloxacin and Dexamethasone Otic Suspension USP, 0.3% / 0.1%, therapeutically equivalent to Sandoz's Ciprodex, in a US$110 mn IQVIA market (12M to Jun-2026).
Cumulative ANDA approvals stand at 246 (226 final, 20 tentative).
Alvesta Pharmaceuticals FZCO incorporated in Dubai, UAE as a step-down WOS with AED 100,000 capital.
USFDA final approval for Valganciclovir for Oral Solution, 50 mg/mL, taking cumulative ANDA approvals to 247 (227 final, 20 tentative).

timeline.summary: On 22 April 2026, Alembic Pharmaceuticals incorporated a 99.99% subsidiary named Alembic Lifesciences Philippines Inc.
On April 23, 2026, Alembic Pharmaceuticals incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Alembic Pharmaceuticals GmbH, in Germany.
On 25 April 2026, Alembic Pharmaceuticals announced receiving USFDA final approval for Fingolimod Capsules 0.5 mg.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals received USFDA tentative approval for Darolutamide Tablets, 300 mg.
On 13 May 2026, Alembic Pharmaceuticals received the USFDA Establishment Inspection Report for its Karakhadi injectable facility following a February audit.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,847.72 Cr (+4.4% YoY), net profit ₹201.54 Cr (+28.7% YoY).
Alembic Pharmaceuticals reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹1,848 Cr and PAT of ₹203 Cr, announcing its entry into the US branded pharmaceuticals market.
Manisha Saraf, SARAF, hosted the audio recording of Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited’s post-results conference call on 15th May 2026.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals' Karakhadi API-III facility cleared a Brazil ANVISA GMP inspection with zero observations on 15 May 2026.
Chirayu Ramanbhai Amin and related promoters declared no encumbrances on Alembic Pharmaceuticals shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Alembic Pharma guided for low double-digit revenue growth, ₹750–800 Cr R&D, and ₹300–350 Cr capex for FY27.
On June 5, 2026, Alembic Pharmaceuticals received USFDA final approval for Haloperidol Tablets.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals executed a shareholders' agreement to acquire a 45% equity stake in a newly incorporated Canadian Corporation.
On its 4 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Alembic reported revenue up 26% YoY to ₹2,150 Cr and raised its FY27 growth outlook to mid-teens from low double-digit.
2026-10-17: Alembic received USFDA final approval for its ANDA for Ciprofloxacin and Dexamethasone Otic Suspension USP, 0.3% / 0.1%, a US$110 mn IQVIA market, taking cumulative ANDA approvals to 246.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals announced that its step-down WOS Alvesta Pharmaceuticals FZCO was incorporated in Dubai on September 1, 2026.
Alembic Pharmaceuticals received USFDA final approval for Valganciclovir for Oral Solution, 50 mg/mL, taking its cumulative ANDA approvals to 247.
